soldier: Head of the soldier yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, short setae sparsely covering the body. Head capsule rectangular, lateral margins nearly parallel, frontal peaks raised. Labrum shaped like a hexagonal turtle shell, the semi-transparent area at the labral tip a broad triangle; apical, lateral apical and subapical setae totalling six and of roughly equal length, the four labral ridge setae rather long. Mandibular apex slightly curved, the peak at the base of the outer margin very small. About 9 setae along the margin of the lacinia. Antennae 14–16 segments. Narrow region of the postmentum rather broad. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both rather deeply incised; more than 20 setae in the middle region.
